'''2000 Swedish National Championship''' was a Star Wars CCG national championship held in Lund, Sweden on 8 April 2000. [[Martin Akesson]] won it. It is known from Martin Akesson's tournament report.<ref name="tr-d504">[https://www.stephenskilton.com/decktech_archives/reports/2000-04-11-swedish-championshipsd504/ swedish-championships], DeckTech (Martin "Mart" Akesson, 11 April 2000). Preservation copy: [https://stevetotheizz0.github.io/decktech_archives/reports/2000-04-11-swedish-championshipsd504/ GitHub Pages].</ref>

* '''Date:''' 8 April 2000
* '''Site:''' Lund, Sweden
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Endor]]
* '''Players:''' 33
* '''Winner:''' [[Martin Akesson]]
